svg.text: Details - strap, cable pocket, page hinge section, elastic section
Cardboard prototype (photos 1-5) + client reference photos (Rev B)
SHEET 7 - DETAILS - STRAP, CABLE POCKET, PAGE HINGE SECTION, ELASTIC SECTION
DETAIL B - STRAP, flat, 1:2 (dark brown faux leather, 2 ply, edge-stitched 0.3)
BUCKLE PIECE - 3.0 x 8.0 loop round the 30 mm buckle bar, stitched to the top flap under the strap with the bar 2.6 below the flap edge; keeper 3.4 x 0.7 stitched 1.3 below the buckle
Buckle: 30 mm (1 1/4 in) antique brass, roller or plain; prong engages the strap holes.
Closure is the snap: the buckle is decorative unless Q3 (sheet 2) says otherwise.
DETAIL D - CABLE POCKET on the inner face of the back panel, behind page 1 (1:2)
- Slip pocket, faux leather lining 0.6 mm, sides and
bottom stitched to the back-panel lining before
the shell is assembled; 15 mm elastic in the top hem
- Alternative (Q5): put the cables in page 4's pocket
and use this pocket for a pattern card.
DETAIL C - PAGE HINGE, section through the bottom gusset, 2:1
bottom gusset: outer 1.0 mm + 1.0 mm board + lining
- Each page's 1.5 hinge tab folds toward the front and is
stitched through the gusset (lining + board + outer) on
one line, 0.5 from the fold. Seams staggered 1.2 apart
so the four pages fan open (reference photo).
- Stitch pages P1 to P4 in order from the back; the front
panel seam is last. The gusset outer face shows four
parallel stitch lines - use the same contrast thread.
2 tips side by side (1 pair), under 15 mm elastic
